system.description:
The Guild is the continent-wide network out of Opal, working closely with Opal's government; many members worship Mask. Robins are its main force, trusted with most day-to-day jobs, and at this level the work is mostly theft and information.

  • Guild Contract: when your Exploit hits, the next ally to attack that target before your next turn has Advantage.
    • 9th level: every ally's first attack against that target before your next turn has Advantage, and once per round you can pick a lock or slip a manacle as part of your movement.
  • Guild Signal: Advantage on checks to gather information for a Crow or Raven superior, and to recognise other Guild members by their signals and methods.
